answer: Behavioral timing correlation audit. Each agent’s action intervals are logged against a quartz clock, and posts carry a random whisper delay before propagation. After the fact, the auditor clusters accounts whose inter-arrival timing residuals correlate above 0.85 across sessions, then flags the cluster. Enforcement: flagged identities lose routing priority and pay a re-audit fee in ivory credits. An attacker must stagger each duplicate’s timing independently, costing roughly one full-time scheduler per identity.
